```{r}
df %>% group_by(k,nclass) %>%
  filter(me == "high me") %>%
  summarise(maxismode = mean(maxismode,na.rm = T),
            converge = round(mean(converge_n,na.rm = T)/500,2)) %>%
  arrange(nclass)
  
  df %>% group_by(k,nclass) %>%
  filter(me == "low me") %>%
  summarise(maxismode = mean(maxismode,na.rm = T),
            converge = round(mean(converge_n,na.rm = T)/500,2)) %>%
    arrange(nclass)
```

```{r}
plot_dat <- df |>
  mutate(
    sample_size = factor(
      ss,
      levels = c("small", "large"),
      labels = c("400", "1,000")
    ),
    measurement_error = factor(
      me,
      levels = c("low me", "high me"),
      labels = c("Low", "High")
    ),
    prevalence = factor(
      prev,
      levels = c("equal", "unequal"),
      labels = c("Balanced", "Unbalanced")
    ),
    true_classes = factor(
      nclass,
      levels = c("3", "5"),
      labels = c("3 classes", "5 classes")
    ),
    items = factor(
      nitem,
      levels = c("7", "10"),
      labels = c("7 items", "10 items")
    ),
    fitted_model = factor(
      k,
      levels = c("k", "k-1"),
      labels = c("K", "K−1")
    )
  )

maxismode_summary <- plot_dat |>
  group_by(
    fitted_model,
    sample_size,
    measurement_error,
    prevalence,
    true_classes,
    items
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_defined = sum(!is.na(maxismode)),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(maxismode)),
    n_maxismode = sum(maxismode, na.rm = TRUE),
    maxismode_prop = mean(maxismode, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

maxismode_summary <- maxismode_summary |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = if_else(
      n_maxismode == 0,
      0,
      qbeta(
        0.025,
        n_maxismode,
        n_defined - n_maxismode + 1
      )
    ),
    ci_upper = if_else(
      n_maxismode == n_defined,
      1,
      qbeta(
        0.975,
        n_maxismode + 1,
        n_defined - n_maxismode
      )
    )
  )

maxismode_summary
library(scales)
p <- ggplot(
  maxismode_summary,
  aes(
    x = sample_size,
    y = maxismode_prop,
    color = measurement_error,
    group = interaction(measurement_error, prevalence)
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(linetype = prevalence),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.12)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lower,
      ymax = ci_upper,
      linetype = prevalence
    ),
    width = 0.06,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.12),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = prevalence),
    size = 2.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.12)
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(fitted_model),
    cols = vars(true_classes, items)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = label_percent()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Low" = "#0072B2", "High" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample size",
    y = "Proportion where maximum is the modal solution",
    color = "Measurement error",
    shape = "Class prevalence",
    linetype = "Class prevalence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

p
```
```{r}
paired_dat <- plot_dat |>
  mutate(
    model_key = case_when(
      fitted_model == "K"   ~ "K",
      fitted_model == "K−1" ~ "Km1"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    sim_number,
    dataset,
    sample_size,
    measurement_error,
    prevalence,
    true_classes,
    items,
    model_key,
    maxismode
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model_key,
    values_from = maxismode,
    names_prefix = "maxismode_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pair_defined = !is.na(maxismode_K) &
      !is.na(maxismode_Km1),

    k_false_km1_true = case_when(
      pair_defined ~ !maxismode_K & maxismode_Km1,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )
paired_summary <- paired_dat |>
  group_by(
    sample_size,
    measurement_error,
    prevalence,
    true_classes,
    items
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_total_pairs = n(),
    n_defined_pairs = sum(pair_defined),
    n_missing_pairs = sum(!pair_defined),

    n_k_false_km1_true = sum(
      k_false_km1_true,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    prop_k_false_km1_true = mean(
      k_false_km1_true,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
paired_summary <- paired_summary |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = case_when(
      n_defined_pairs == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      n_k_false_km1_true == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ qbeta(
        0.025,
        n_k_false_km1_true,
        n_defined_pairs - n_k_false_km1_true + 1
      )
    ),

    ci_upper = case_when(
      n_defined_pairs == 0 ~ NA_real_,
      n_k_false_km1_true == n_defined_pairs ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ qbeta(
        0.975,
        n_k_false_km1_true + 1,
        n_defined_pairs - n_k_false_km1_true
      )
    )
  )

p_paired <- ggplot(
  paired_summary,
  aes(
    x = sample_size,
    y = prop_k_false_km1_true,
    color = measurement_error,
    group = interaction(
      measurement_error,
      prevalence
    )
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(linetype = prevalence),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.12)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lower,
      ymax = ci_upper,
      linetype = prevalence
    ),
    width = 0.06,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.12),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = prevalence),
    size = 2.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.12)
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    cols = vars(true_classes, items)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = label_percent()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Low" = "#0072B2",
      "High" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample size",
    y = paste0(
      "Proportion of datasets where K is not modal\n",
      "but K−1 is modal"
    ),
    color = "Measurement error",
    shape = "Class prevalence",
    linetype = "Class prevalence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

p_paired
```
